header.work: Full Stack Web Developer & Software Engineer
header.eslogan: I build modern, scalable, and interactive web applications.

about.intro: Hi! I'm **Adrià**, and I'm passionate about building things. I'm a **full stack developer** specializing in crafting modern, interactive web applications using **React, TypeScript, Node.js**, and **PHP**. I take pride in writing clean, scalable code and transforming complex requirements into seamless user experiences.
about.main: My technical foundation is firmly anchored in **42 Barcelona**, where I completed the demanding **Common Core**. This methodology has provided me with strong problem-solving skills, algorithmic thinking, and great adaptability to any tech stack through hands-on learning.
about.end: Beyond web and software development, I occasionally revisit old projects from when I was experimenting with game development (like that 2D Unity shooter or 3D puzzles), keeping my passion for creative programming alive.

footer: Designed in **Excalidraw** and coded locally in **Visual Studio Code** by yours truly. Built with **React, TypeScript**, and **SCSS**, and deployed on **GitHub Pages**.

lluna.title: Llar d'Infants Escola Infantil La Lluna Website
lluna.company: Llar d'Infants Escola Infantil La Lluna
lluna.desc: My first professional project. Directly managed **client communication** to structure, design, and launch their corporate website from scratch using WordPress and Elementor.

codelive.title: Codelive Website
codelive.desc: Interactive learning platform. **My first project with Node.js**, where I built the backend and the 'Try It Yourself' interactive live-code sandbox (HTML, CSS, JS, PHP, and PostgreSQL).

pong.title: Pong Github
pong.desc: Interactive web application. **My first project with React and TypeScript**, featuring **real-time chat**, multiplayer matchmaking, and an AI bot opponent.

camagru.title: Camagru Github
camagru.desc: Instagram-inspired social network. Features a server-side **image processing module** to composite photos with stickers, handle rotations, and dynamic scaling.

webforge.title: In progress
webforge.desc: Web platform to quickly generate HTML, CSS, and JS. Similar to WordPress but focused on downloading pages, components, and color palettes.

webserv.title: Webserv Github
webserv.desc: HTTP/1.1 web server built entirely in **C++98** from scratch. Implements **non-blocking I/O** (`epoll`/`select`), CGI script execution, socket management, and HTTP methods.

inception.title: Inception Github
inception.desc: Modular service infrastructure built with **Docker and Docker Compose**. Configured a secure multi-container environment with Nginx, WordPress (FPM), and MariaDB with persistent volumes and SSL/TLS.

minirt.title: miniRT Github
minirt.desc: 3D **Ray Tracing** rendering engine written in C. Computes basic lighting, shadows, reflections, and 3D geometry using vector mathematics and algebraic calculations.

philo.title: Philosophers Github
philo.desc: C implementation solving the classic **Dining Philosophers** concurrency problem. Implements **threads**, **mutexes**, and safeguards to prevent *deadlocks* and race conditions.

minishell.title: Minishell Github
minishell.desc: C recreation of a **Unix command shell** (Bash-like). Features a custom parser, **pipe** handling, redirections, environment variables, and process management (`fork`, `execve`).

play.title: Play With Me
play.desc: A beat-the-clock puzzle game in **Unity 3D** where you play as a jealous toy sabotaging its owner's new belongings (comic books, consoles, TVs...) before the child returns to the room. As part of the team, I developed the comic book area and the interaction mechanic of destroying them by throwing paint.

run.title: Run 3D
run.desc: Fast-paced **3D runner** game where you start with a single character and must multiply and guide your crowd through an obstacle-filled course. The goal is to find the best routes, dodge lethal traps, and reach the finish line with as many survivors as possible.

escape.title: Escape from the Lab
escape.work: Escape from the Lab - Unity 2D Developer
escape.desc: Platform shooter in **Unity 2D** with a strong emphasis on agility and precision. Combines parkour mechanics and moving platforms with ranged combat against waves of enemies and challenging bosses. Features a reward system with interactive chests and collectible items.

isaac.title: Isaac
isaac.desc: 2D web game recreation inspired by **The Binding of Isaac**, built with **JavaScript** (ES6) and **Phaser 3**. Features directional shooting mechanics, layer collision system with Tiled, enemy pursuit **AI**, boss battles, and a responsive design.

outer.title: 42 Barcelona (Outer Core)
outer.desc: Advanced specialization phase focused on two complementary domains: **Full Stack Web Development** (real-time applications with WebSockets, video streaming, MVC architecture with Django, and web security) and **Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure** (cloud deployment, CI/CD pipelines, process supervision, and network diagnostic tools using raw TCP/IP sockets).

web.title: Full Stack Web
web.desc: Intensive technical program focused on the full cycle of web development (**Full Stack**). Building interactive and responsive frontend applications (**HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+**), backend API development with **PHP** and **Node.js**, relational database modeling and queries (**MySQL**), and data structure management and exchange with **JSON** and **XML**. Practical emphasis on client-server architectures, web security fundamentals, and real-world project development.

common.title: 42 Barcelona (Common Core)
common.desc: Intensive core curriculum focused on algorithms, systems programming, and software development without external libraries. Built high-complexity projects from scratch in **C and C++**: Unix architecture (**Minishell**), concurrency and multithreading (**Philosophers**), 3D graphic rendering (**MiniRT**), non-blocking I/O HTTP server (**Webserv**), container virtualization with **Docker** (**Inception**), and real-time interactive web development (**Transcendence**).

ifp.title: Planeta FP (Video Games)
ifp.desc: Higher Vocational Education program focused on the design, architecture, and programming of interactive applications and 2D/3D video games. Game logic and mechanics development in **Unity** with **C#** (component-based architecture, physics, state machines, and user interfaces) and interactive web games using **Phaser** and **JavaScript**. Solid grounding in **Object-Oriented Programming** (**OOP**), vector mathematics, resource optimization, and agile production workflows.
